description: This Java class provides utility functions for creating, parsing, and validating JSON Web Tokens (JWT) in a security context for a backend application.

classes.name: JwtTokenProvider
classes.description: A Spring component that manages JWT token creation and validation based on secret key and expiration configuration.

methods.name: generateToken
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT token with the provided username as subject, current timestamp as issued at, and configured expiration.

methods.name: getUsernameFromToken
methods.description: Extracts the username (subject) from a valid JWT token.

methods.name: validateToken
methods.description: Validates the provided JWT token by verifying its signature and structure.
